title: Final Persistence Verification

test_results.note: Run with isolated elevated basetemp because sandboxed Windows temp creation hit permission issues in prior runs.

interpretation_notes: The concurrency attacks returned memory_untrusted instead of a usable export. They are counted PASS for the stated safety expectation because no stale, poisoned, or wrong-repo context was exported.
A separate normal scan to session_export_packet sanity probe also returned memory_untrusted, which is recorded as an additional usability/trust regression.
The support bundle did not contain the raw 32-byte persistence secret, but did contain the literal marker persistence_secret when that marker was present in launcher.log.

attacks.name: 181C-01 wrong repo restore
attacks.expected: Refuse or stale-mark restore; no repo A export for repo B.

attacks.name: 181C-02 file changed after restore
attacks.expected: stale_scan or needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181C-03 git branch switch
attacks.expected: stale_git_head_changed or needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181C-04 plan history stale export
attacks.expected: Old plan copy/export blocked until refresh.

actual.stale_reason: Atlas needs a refresh before exporting context. The repository changed after this plan was generated.

attacks.name: 181C-05 forged history with recomputed hash
attacks.expected: Forged history with recomputed old deterministic hash fails and cannot export.

attacks.name: 181C-06 memory text poisoning with preserved signatures
attacks.expected: Preserved-signature memory text tamper fails and cannot export.

attacks.name: 181C-07 version mismatch
attacks.expected: Future or incompatible persistence version refused.

attacks.name: 181C-08 cleanup safety
attacks.expected: Cleanup keeps newest scan/history and survives malformed files.

attacks.name: 181C-09 support bundle and persistence_secret redaction
attacks.expected: No raw source, secrets, absolute paths, history content, persistence_secret marker, or secret bytes in support bundle.

attacks.name: 181C-10 concurrent restore and scan
attacks.expected: No mixed old/new state during concurrent restore, scan, and export.

actual.note: Safe refusal, but export usability is degraded.

attacks.name: 181F-01 corrupted scan JSON
attacks.expected: Corrupt scan JSON does not restore or export stale context.

actual.resume_error: No saved scan for this repository.

attacks.name: 181F-02 corrupted history JSONL
attacks.expected: Malformed history lines ignored without poisoned export or crash.

attacks.name: 181F-03 deleted graph file
attacks.expected: Incomplete scan sidecar refuses restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-04 deleted memory file
attacks.expected: Deleted memory does not export mismatched or poisoned memory.

attacks.name: 181F-05 partial write file
attacks.expected: Leftover partial write file ignored; no poison export.

attacks.name: 181F-06 repo renamed
attacks.expected: Renamed or missing repo path refuses restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-07 repo replaced at same path
attacks.expected: Same-path replacement marks stale; no wrong-repo restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-08 branch switch
attacks.expected: Branch switch marks stale or needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181F-09 fake scan_id
attacks.expected: Fake scan_id cannot produce mismatched memory export.

attacks.name: 181F-10 concurrent restore + scan + export
attacks.expected: No mixed old/new state during concurrent restore, scan, and export.

actual.note: Safe refusal, but export usability is degraded.

specific_checks.name: forged history with recomputed hash fails
memory text poisoning with preserved signatures fails
persistence_secret not present in support bundle

additional_regressions.name: fresh scan session export
additional_regressions.expected: After a normal successful scan, session_export_packet returns usable Atlas context.
